answer: Hardware-bound attestation prices out sybils by tying each identity to a physical secure enclave registered in the protocol's orchard. Each enclave signs a periodic heartbeat whose clock-skew delta against peer signals maps it to a latency meadow. Clones multiplexed on the same host share thermal and clock drift, landing on the same meadow coordinate while an honest newcomer on distinct silicon lands alone. The orchard charges $2^k$ leased enclave-hours per epoch for the $k$-th agent on one coordinate, forcing sybil operators to buy dedicated physical chips per clone or pay exponential bills.
